# Vendored browser libraries

Filled by `npm run vendor` (see `web/package.json`): `mujoco/mujoco.js`, `mujoco/mujoco.wasm` and `mujoco/mujoco.d.ts`
from `@mujoco/mujoco` (the version must equal the Python `mujoco` version: the compiled scene is served as a binary
`.mjb`), `three/three.module.js`, `three/three.core.js` and `three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js` from `three`.
Nothing in this folder but this file is committed.
